item.title: Comment on Noah Smith on L.A: fire lessons by Kaleberg
item.description:
Reply to Hazel Meade:

It's not just about the increasing presence of humans, but about the century long policy of fire suppression, which has lead to a massive buildup of dry tinder in forests and wilderness areas.

Are you familiar with the area? It's dry chaparral. Except in canyons right near the creeks, most seasonal, it's all shrubs and scrubby trees. They smell great. A lot of them are rosemary and sage, so good for cooking. Some are poison oak, but that likes to be near water. It's a suburban area of medium density, so there are a lot of houses on steep hills with modest lots save for a number of gorgeous high end McPalaces.

There is no way one could do a controlled burn without burning down the entire neighborhood. Removing brush would be counter-productive. Those scrubby plants, bushes and trees, help control erosion.

Controlled burns might have helped with the fires north of San Francisco, and were even more likely to have helped even farther north which is heavily forested and much wetter.

The City of Los Angeles came out of this pretty well. The air was bad, but this wasn't an urban fire, so the city was fine. The Los Angeles suburbs did not do as well. Over the past several decades, there has been a revival of urban life in the city proper. Maybe this will spur further urbanization as the suburbs become uninsurable.

As we saw with COVID, there are a lot of people who spout nonsense and get all too much time on the public stage.

item.title: Comment on Congestion Tolls versus Congestion Pricing by Vulcidian
item.description:
"I wish the tolls were dynamic. Price uncertainty is better than time uncertainty (paying $10 more today is fine if you pay $10 less tomorrow, but you can’t compensate being 30 min late for a flight or meeting by being 30 min early to the next one)."

WOW. That's definitely a top 1% way to look at the problem. MOST plebs would much rather know the price so they can adjust their timing. Lord save us from solutions based on the elite's utility functions!
